column2: A fun-loving adult organizes a playful garden game, laughing while offering colorful beanbags to eager friends around a target hoop.
A fundraiser collects voluntary donations for a playground, holding a coin box beside a model of the proposed swings.
A performer walks funnily in oversized shoes, lifting each knee comically high while amused children watch from a bench.
A helper furthers a team's progress by pushing their loaded cart uphill, bringing it closer to the visible workshop entrance.
Several geese gaggle loudly beside a pond, necks extended and beaks open toward the gathering flock.
A victorious runner receives a trophy beside the finish line, with other competitors congratulating them after the race.
A profitable stallholder receives more customer coins than the small supplier payment set aside beside the day's sold goods.
A person's lower leg is shown neutrally from knee to foot, wearing a plain sock and comfortable shoe.
A chess player makes an opening move, advancing a white central pawn while the other pieces remain in their starting positions.
A gamer plays on a console with both hands on a controller, watching a simple platform-game scene on the television.
A gangster leader confers with accomplices in a concealed office, dividing stolen goods while a lookout watches the locked door.
A sturdy wooden barrel stand cradles one horizontal cask, with two raised supports keeping the rounded barrel from rolling.
A plain garter band holds up a stocking on a neutral clothed display leg, with its circular fastening clearly visible.
A flat rubber gasket fits between two matching pipe flanges, with their aligned bolt holes visible around the sealing ring.
A gas-filled soft-drink bottle contains many trapped bubbles, with a newly opened cap and fizz gathering at the mouth.
A gastroenterology specialist studies a stomach-and-intestine model with a patient, beside a digestive-system diagram in a consultation room.
A food scholar compares carefully prepared tasting portions, evaluating aroma and texture with a cook beside the kitchen counter.
A gastronome thoughtfully samples a small refined dish, comparing its components with fresh herbs and ingredients arranged beside the chef.
A small gatehouse stands directly beside a large estate gate, with a viewing window facing everyone approaching the entrance.
A gatekeeper checks an arriving visitor's pass, holding the gate partly closed until the inspection is complete.
An awkward guest knocks one cup while reaching for another, tangling their sleeves and looking embarrassed beside the wobbling tray.
A person gawks open-mouthed at an unusual towering sculpture, staring blankly while other pedestrians simply pass by.
An immeasurably huge pile of small coins overflows a room, with a tiny overwhelmed counter holding an inadequate empty bowl.
Chilled gazpacho fills a bowl with red tomato soup, topped with diced cucumber and pepper beside fresh tomatoes and a cool serving tray.
A gentlemanly adult holds a heavy door open for someone carrying boxes, stepping courteously aside to give them room.
A geophysicist studies a simplified Earth cross-section beside a seismic recording instrument, comparing internal layers with wave traces on the desk.
A speaker communicates through gestures, pointing toward an open doorway while using the other hand to invite a companion forward.
A toy's hidden spring gimmick makes a small wooden bird pop from its box, with a hand lifting the harmless trigger flap.
A ginseng plant shows five-part compound leaves and a forked fleshy root, with red berries clustered above the green stem.
An adult girds their waist with a leather belt, threading its end through the buckle and tightening it over a tunic.
